summary: A later legislative hearing puts a witness’s comparison of campaign spending in a city repeal election on the record.
realLife: Written testimony in a U.S. Senate hearing described Columbia's voter repeal and attributed substantially greater campaign spending to grocery and beverage interests.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: certified result and attributed spending evidence.

turns.pulledBy: The witness relies on an advocacy estimate.
turns.writesBack: The account names the source of the comparison.
